short: An American close air support attack aircraft famous for its durability and rotary cannon.
full:
The Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II entered service in October 1977 as the first US Air Force aircraft designed solely for close air support. Built to counter Soviet armoured thrusts in Europe, it was engineered around the 30mm GAU-8 Avenger rotary cannon. The aircraft features extraordinary survivability, with a titanium "bathtub" protecting the pilot and redundant flight systems designed to withstand heavy ground fire.

Nicknamed the "Warthog", the A-10 distinguished itself during the 1991 Gulf War by destroying more than nine hundred Iraqi tanks and thousands of other vehicles. Despite multiple attempts by the Air Force to retire the fleet in favour of multirole fighters, its unparalleled effectiveness in supporting ground troops has repeatedly extended its service life.
